name: IS4GT Pre-Law and Pre-Med Ed one-week programs (MSU)
what_you_do: Spend one week on a single topic, such as pre-law or pre-med education, on the MSU campus. Commuter only.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 11. It is a program for gifted and talented students.
pay_detail: Fee not stated on the page read. Financial assistance is listed.
duration: One week. 2026 dates: Pre-Law June 15 to 19, Pre-Med Ed July 6 to 10.
deadline_text: 2026 application deadline was May 8, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through the program page on the MSU gifted programs site. Phone 517-432-2129, email gifted@msu.edu.
